The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) has announced the AIIMS NORCET 10 Mains Result 2026 today, i.e., 12th May 2026 [Monday]. Along with the announcement of the results, AIIMS also issued category-wise cut-off marks and a merit list in the form of an online PDF. All those candidates who appeared for the exam can now check and download their online results by simply visiting the official AIIMS website, i.e., aiimsexams.ac.in, and logging in using their respective application number and password/date of birth as login credentials. They can also access the online results through the direct link that will soon be updated in the article below.

AIIMS NORCET 10 Mains Result 2026 OUT

The Nursing Officer Recruitment Common Eligibility Test (NORCET-10) is a national level test held to select qualified nursing professionals for the post of Nursing Officer (Group B) across various AIIMS institutions and participating central government hospitals in India. For the year 2026, AIIMS has announced a total of 2,551 vacancies for the post of nursing officer (Group B) at various AIIMS institutes. After the exams candidates were eagerly waiting for the announcement of their AIIMS NORCET 10 Mains Results, so this is to inform them that the result have now been announced on May 10, 2026. Carefully check the result PDF and prepare for the next step accordingly.

AIIMS NORCET 10 Mains Result PDF Download Link

The official window to check and download the AIIMS NORCET 10 Mains Result 2026 has been activated at the official website of the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) on 11th May 2026. Candidates are required to log in using their respective application number and password that were generated at the time of registration. To make it easier, we have also shared detailed step-by-step process along with a direct link to access Result in the article below. The AIIMS NORCET 10 stage II results comprise all necessary details such as the student’s name, marks scored, pass/fail status and much more.

AIIMS NORCET 10 Mains Result 2026 OUT: Click to Download PDF

How to Download AIIMS NORCET 10 Result 2026 at aiimsexams.ac.in?

To check and download AIIMS NORCET 10 Result 2026 PDF, candidates can either click on direct link shared above or follow detailed step-by-step process discussed below: Step 1: Visit official All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) website, i.e., aiimsexams.ac.in. Step 2: Search for latest updates section on homepage of AIIMS website. Step 3: Look for “AIIMS NORCET 10 Mains Result 2026” PDF download link and click on it. Step 4: Enter all necessary details such as: application number and password/date of birth on the login window. Step 6: Your NORCET 10 Result 2026 PDF will be displayed. Step 7: At the end make sure you save and download the result PDF for further use.

Answer: To download the AIIMS NORCET 10 Mains Result 2026, candidates are required to visit the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) website.
